newsitem.title: DUBAI: Kuwait defence minister arrives in UAE for talks.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait defence minister arrives in UAE for talks.

text.p: Kuwait's defence minister arrived in the United Arab Emirates on Wednesday on the fourth leg of whirlwind regional tour to rally support among 1991 Gulf War allies for a fresh U.S. military buildup in the region.

Sheikh Ahmad Hamoud al-Jaber al-Sabah arrived in Al-Ain, in Abu Dhabi emirate, and met UAE Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Sheikh Hamdan bin Zaid al-Nahayan, the official UAE news agency WAM reported. It gave no further details.
Sheikh Ahmad is on a shuttle mission to Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states aimed at keeping the old anti-Iraq coalition firmly in place.

The GCC is an economic, political and military alliance which groups Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and the UAE. He has already visited regional heavyweight Saudi Arabia, the island state of Bahrain and Qatar.
Kuwait on Monday agreed to receive more U.S. soldiers and stressed it would not hesitate to take further measures to deter what its sees as threats by former occupier Iraq.
